intent: Read the old receipt in /uploads/, recompute today's catalog total (excl VAT) for its line items, and answer whether the difference vs the old receipt total stays within 1 EUR.
success_criteria: Receipt file located and read from /uploads/
Every receipt line item (SKU + quantity + old unit price excl VAT) extracted
Each SKU resolved to current product_variants.price_cents from the catalog
Old total (excl VAT) and today's total (excl VAT) summed in same currency
abs(today_total - old_total) compared against 1 EUR (100 cents)
Answer includes <YES> or <NO> token per AGENTS.MD

args: SELECT product_sku, product_name, price_cents, price_currency FROM product_variants WHERE product_sku IN (:receipt_skus);

WITH receipt(product_sku, qty, old_unit_cents) AS (VALUES :receipt_lines), today AS (SELECT r.product_sku, r.qty, r.old_unit_cents, v.price_cents AS new_unit_cents FROM receipt r JOIN product_variants v ON v.product_sku = r.product_sku) SELECT SUM(qty*old_unit_cents) AS old_total_cents, SUM(qty*new_unit_cents) AS new_total_cents, SUM(qty*new_unit_cents) - SUM(qty*old_unit_cents) AS diff_cents, ABS(SUM(qty*new_unit_cents) - SUM(qty*old_unit_cents)) <= 100 AS within_one_eur FROM today;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: Old receipt $receipt_path total (excl VAT) = {comparison.old_total_cents/100} EUR; today's catalog total (excl VAT) = {comparison.new_total_cents/100} EUR; difference = {comparison.diff_cents/100} EUR. Within 1 EUR: {within_one_eur ? '<YES>' : '<NO>'}.
